name: Title deck and interview spread
prompt: High-fidelity desktop About-page composition probe for Alex Metelli’s editorial engineering portfolio. A compact site header leads into a full-width typographic title deck with About / Working Notes, the headline ‘Engineering work built around correctness, clarity, and delivery.’, and a short lead. Below it, three large numbered interview questions stack on the left while the real portrait is inset on the right with a caption and contact action. A lower horizontal capability index and three rule-separated principles complete the page. Warm paper, deep navy ink, Georgia-like serif display, restrained evidence blue, sans body, square geometry, hairline rules, no gradients, shadows, cards, dashboard chrome, or invented claims.
